summary: Sandbach United is gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having recently welcomed several new signings and a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers suffered a narrow defeat to St Helens in their latest friendly, where their opponents' clinical finishing made the difference in a closely contested match. With three brand new kits ready to go and player details being revealed, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities as they prepare for their promotion push.
